purpose: Document official city parcel-source evidence, bounded anonymous geometry route review, and remaining coverage/runtime limits.
assessment: A 200 m by 200 m projected bbox around the exact Seville WUP centroid returned 104 full CP features; only three were retained. A 20 m by 20 m bbox around the WUP point returned no records. No citywide completeness or point-intersection is claimed.
registryAssessment: The Spanish Directorate General for Cadastre publishes the INSPIRE Cadastral Parcel dataset and public WFS/ATOM services. The live WFS advertises the CadastralParcel feature and returned full geometry in Seville at the city locator’s nearby window.

officialPrimarySources.observation: DG Catastro describes INSPIRE CP, official WFS and per-municipality ATOM parcel downloads.
Official WFS documentation describes BBOX GetFeature requests, CP feature type, and service query behavior.
Official INSPIRE use licence; attribution/transform and reuse conditions must be followed for downstream use.

serviceChecks.observation: No records returned for this small locator window.

serviceChecks.method: GET WFS GetFeature with 200 m x 200 m EPSG:25830 bbox centered at WUP locator; COUNT=3
serviceChecks.observation: 104 full CP polygons were returned despite requested count=3; only three complete safe geometries were retained. The schema returned area, parcel reference, timestamps/labels and geometry, with no owner/address fields.

privacy: No owner, personal title, or address data was requested or retained. Native parcel identifiers and polygon geometry are retained only where the official public schema supports them.

qualification.note: No adapter protocol qualification or shared runtime integration was performed.
